text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—But, still... it gave me chills! Akebono 
really is amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Next, next, next! Never give up, yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the grand stage, Hishi 
Akebono was embraced by a massive round of 
applause.

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* She's on a whole other level of 
intense!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! Buono-chan's races are just the 
best, aren't they?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I knew it. I've seen it so many 
times, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the thunderous cheers, Hishi 
Akebono dashed off toward the underground 
tunnel.
